input.question: how do zits form, and why does popping certain zits hurt like a bitch (lip line) and others don't (forehead)
input.ground_truth: There are different kinds of breakout. Whiteheads and blackheads are simply clogged pores; the oil in the pore is either blocked, trapping the bacteria in the pore, or it is exposed to air, where the bacteria oxidizes and forms a whitehead. A pimple, or zit, when the bacteria deeper down in the pore becomes infected and inflamed, and these can be painful. Depending on the location, you can experiences different degrees of pain. There are many more sensitive nerve endings around the lip area, so you feel so many more sensations. That's why kissing someone feels so good, and why cold sores hurt like a mutha.

Explain the following question in a simple way as if you are explaining to a 5-year-old.

Question: how do zits form, and why does popping certain zits hurt like a bitch (lip line) and others don't (forehead)

Answer:

response.prediction:
Okay, let’s explain it like you’re five!

When you have zits (those little bumps on your skin), it’s because some stuff inside your skin gets clogged up, like dirt, oil, and tiny bits of old skin. Imagine a straw with a bunch of stuff stuck inside—it gets all bumpy and sore!

Now, some zits are on your lips (that’s called the “lip line”), and some are on your forehead.

When you try to pop a zit on your lip, it can really hurt! That’s because the skin on your lips is very thin and sensitive—kind of like the skin on your lips is wearing a tiny, tiny dress that’s easy to tear. The stuff inside the zit is also squished up tight and there are lots of nerves (those are like tiny wires that tell your brain “ouch!”). So when you push on it, those nerves yell really loud and it hurts a lot!

But zits on your forehead have thicker skin and the stuff inside isn’t always as squished or close to those “ouch” wires. So when you try to pop them, it might not hurt as much.

So, zits happen when stuff gets stuck, and where they are on your face changes how much it hurts if you try to pop them!
